messages:
incident-bot: [ALERT] PagerDuty -> inference-gateway-prod: 5xx-rate spike detected (90s window). error_rate=12.3% threshold=5%. auto-paging oncall @eli
pagerduty: Pager opened: INC-2026-4521 assigned -> eli (on-call) — escalation policy: primary->secondary after 5m
eli: ack INC-2026-4521, jumping in. first check: which path is spiking? any customer-facing routes?
maria: quick telemetry: eu-west1 ingress shows 5xx concentrated on /v1/generate (rps normal). upstreams show 502s from kv-proxy pool-3.
raj: rolling logs show rapid `502 Bad Gateway` from kvcache-proxy: `context deadline exceeded` + `connection reset by peer` around 1795126700. attaching snippet:
```
2026-03-12T03:11:40Z proxy[pool-3]: proxy->kvcache timeout hitting 200ms limit, err="context deadline exceeded"
2026-03-12T03:11:41Z proxy[pool-3]: upstream conn reset, remote=10.12.3.45:4040
```
eli: ok, thanks. that points to KV cache layer flapping. runbook: https://runbooks.redwood/inference-5xx — step 1: check kvcache metrics (evictions, latency), step 2: healthcheck hosts, step 3: fail traffic to fallback region if needed.
camille: customers: a handful of enterprise customers in EU are seeing failures; support is getting tickets. severity: degraded but not full outage.
ops-bot: kvcache pool-3 hosts: host-3b (unhealthy), host-3c (high latency). marking host-3b out of rotation (cordon) temporarily. actioned by ops-bot at 1795126725.
eli: good. draining host-3c now. triggering immediate soft-failover for /v1/generate in eu-west1 -> fallback eu-west2 (weight shift 80/20) via routing service.
maria: shifting weights now — 80% -> eu-west2. latency spike subsiding on new requests, 5xx dropping to ~3.5% in last 30s.
raj: putting a short-term guard: reduce kvcache client timeout from 200ms -> 400ms to avoid transient cancels while we stabilize. will monitor error budget impact.
camille: notifying impacted customers with a brief note: "We detected elevated 5xx rates for inference; routing has been adjusted and we're monitoring. No data loss expected."
eli: keeping INC-2026-4521 open. ETA next update in 10m. tagging @maria @raj for followups.
maria: monitoring graphs: errors trending down. KV cache evictions were high — will follow up root cause (regression in eviction algorithm?) in a postmortem.
pagerduty: INC-2026-4521: ack by eli at 1795126730. escalation timer paused.
eli: thanks team — if 5xx stays <5% for 10m and no new regressions, I'll resolve. otherwise, escalate to infra lead. :thumbsup:
camille: filed a customer-facing status update draft in #support-drafts, pinged @ops for approval.
ops-bot: host-3b remains cordoned; host-3c drain complete. will auto-rejoin after healthcheck passes.
eli: closing note: short mitigation succeeded (traffic divert + host cordon). follow-ups: 1) postmortem on kvcache evictions, 2) consider backoff on client timeouts, 3) add a middle-layer circuit breaker to prevent proxy cascades.
eli: resolving INC-2026-4521 in 9m if stable.
(brief silence, then)
maria: 10m check — sustained <4% 5xx, no new alerts. recommending resolve.
eli: resolve INC-2026-4521. :white_check_mark:
pagerduty: INC-2026-4521 status -> resolved by eli at 1795126849
incident-bot: Incident closed. summary: KV proxy timeouts caused transient 502s; mitigated by cordoning unhealthy hosts and diverting traffic to fallback region. action items assigned for follow-up PMs.
